summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial studies the use of the drug liraglutide for people with obesity and metabolism-associated fatty liver disease, a condition where extra fat builds up in the liver. The study has an enrollment of 102 participants and is sponsored by the Affiliated Hospital of Nantong University. The status of the study is currently listed as Unknown status. Researchers will compare how different combinations of lifestyle changes, diet, exercise, and medications like liraglutide and orlistat affect body weight and liver health over three months.
